tool_args.prompt: Create ONE complete transparent-background character asset of the Giant Majini from Resident Evil 5 (2009), using these two images of the SAME source character render. Use the FIRST to preserve the complete spiked club. Preserve the huge tall gray-green humanoid body, long bare legs, pale body-paint lines on the torso, bare feet with the source ankle bands, narrow green wrapped loin covering and rope belt, thick knotted red/green wrist ornaments, upper-arm band and the exact huge wooden tribal mask. The mask has its source four cylindrical openings, projecting cheek tusks, toothed lower face and radiating layered leaf/wood headdress; show the appropriate perspective, never a new human face. Anatomical RIGHT hand alone carries the very large short-handled club with its bound wooden head and many long spikes; anatomical LEFT hand stays free, with natural fingers. Do not swap these hands. Preserve the unusual source silhouette and all accessories without redesigning them, adding new ornaments or mixing another Majini. One neutral ready stance, single subject, original textured survival-horror rendering and real alpha. Every feather/wood crest tip, finger, bare foot, shaft end and each club spike must be FULLY inside the image with at least 10 percent entirely transparent margin on all four sides. Scale down the subject and club together to fit. No software mirror, montage, duplicated limbs, backdrop, floor, scene, shadow panel, text, logo, glow or border. Preserve only source wear without extra injury. A generated static interpretation, not a certified native frame or animation. Physically turn the whole character to face SCREEN LEFT in a side-dominant three-quarter stance. Mask profile, torso and knees aim left. The nearer anatomical LEFT arm is free; the farther anatomical RIGHT arm holds the club, with the club head carried low and forward toward the left, fully visible without changing arm ownership. Do not mirror the native pose.
